dedupe_keys.name: a gridded standardized precipitation evapotranspiration index dataset for china spanning the past millennium

description: A gridded standardized precipitation evapotranspiration index dataset for China spanning the past millennium is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Miao Fang et al. The lack of reliable, spatiotemporally-completed and millennium-long drought dataset for China has limited a full-field and accurate understanding of drought variability over the past millennium. Here, we present a millennium-long gridded dataset of summer (June-August) Standardized Precipitation Evapotranspiration Index (SPEI) for China at 1.875° spatial resolution and annual temporal resolution. Coverage: national (CN); published in 2026. The formats are not stated in the sources read. The paper's page was read, but no repository address could be taken from its machine-readable metadata, so the record links to the article, whose Data Records section names where the data sit. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
